Water · Rivers · Resilience

Science and modelling for resilient water systems.

Senior adviser and researcher working at the intersection of river hydraulics, sediment dynamics, flood risk and operational modelling.

Explore my work

About me

I work on complex water and river challenges, connecting scientific understanding with practical modelling and decision support. My interests span hydraulic and hydrological modelling, river morphology, sediment management, flood-risk assessment and digital-twin applications.

Areas of expertise

River hydraulics

Hydrodynamic analysis and modelling of rivers, channels and connected water systems, including applications with Delft3D FM.

Sediment & morphology

Understanding sediment transport, morphological change, river interventions and sediment-management strategies.

Flood risk

Catchment-to-city flood analysis, risk assessment and the translation of modelling results into practical resilience measures.

Digital twins

Connecting models, observations and operational workflows to support forecasting, scenario assessment and decision-making.

Model strategy

Selection and integration of fit-for-purpose hydrological and hydraulic modelling approaches for complex projects.

International projects

Applied research and advisory work across diverse river basins, climates and institutional settings.

Selected projects

A selection of themes from my international work. Project descriptions can be expanded with approved public information.

Jeddah flood management

Flood modelling and digital-twin approaches supporting urban flood-management applications.

Bangladesh river systems

River-system and off-take management questions involving hydraulics, morphology and intervention strategies.

Fly River / Ok Tedi

Sediment investigation and survey-planning themes, including sediment provenance and river navigation challenges.
